to begin before: ; c. acc., τὸ θέλειν, (not elsewhere).†

G4295.as:
πρό-κειμαι, [in LXX: Ex 39:18 (36), Nu 4:7 (פָּנִים), etc.;] used as pass. of προτίθημι;
1. to be set before one, to be set forth: , , .
2. to present oneself, be present: (v. Mey., in l.).†

G4294.as:
* προ-κατ-αρτίζω,
to make ready beforehand: .†

G4255.as:
προ-αιρέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: for חשׁק, etc.;]
to bring forth or forward. Most freq. in mid., to take by choice, prefer, propose: .†

G4258.as:
*† προ-αμαρτάνω,
to sin before: .†

G4283.as:
*† προ-ευαγγελίζομαι,
to announce glad tidings beforehand: .†

G4287.as:
** προ-θέσμιος, -α, -ον, [in Sm.: Jb 28:3, Da 9:26*;]
appointed beforehand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time: .†

G4277.as:
** προ-εῖπον, 2 aor. from unused Pres. (v.s. εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (III Mac 6:35*), pass., -είρημαι (II Mac 2:32, III Mac 1:26, al.),
1. to say before: , (on the form -αμεν, v. WH, App., 164), ; seq. ὅτι, , ; of prophecy, , , , , , .
2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in , , (cf. προλέγω; but v. supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†

G4240.as:
πραΰτης (Rec. -ότης, exc. , , where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Ps 44 (45):4 89 (90):10 131 (132):1 (עַנְוָה, עֻנּוֹת, Es 5:1, Si6*;]
gentleness, meekness: , , , , (v. Lft., in l.), , , , .†
SYN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v.

G4292.as:
** προ-καλέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: II Mac 8:11 A*;]
to call forth. Most freq. in mid.,
(a) to challenge; hence, to provoke: ;
(b) to invite (II Mac 8:11).†

G4276.as:
*† προ-ελπίζω,
to hope before: seq. ἐν, .†

G4297.as:
**† προ-κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ (< προκόπτω), [in LXX: Si 51:17, II Mac 8:8*;]
progress (prop., on a journey, then generally): , , (condemned by Atticists, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 158).†

G4257.as:
* προ-ακούω,
to hear beforehand: (v. Lft., in l.).†

G4269.as:
** πρό-γονος, -ον (< προγίνομαι), [in LXX: Es 4:17, Si 8:4, al.;]
1. born before.
2. As subst., in pl., οἱ π., ancestors, forefathers: ; of living parents (so Plat.), .†

G4299.as:
*† πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό (< cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand),
pre-judging, prejudice: (v. Cremer, 378).†

G4271.as:
** πρό-δηλος, -ον, [in LXX: Jth 8:29, II Mac 3:17 14:39*;]
1. evident beforehand.
2. clearly evident: , , .†

G4200.as:
**† πορισμός, -ου, ὁ (< πορίζω, to procure), [in LXX: Wi 13:19 14:2*;]
1. a providing.
2. a means of gain: , (Polyb., al.).†

G4230.as:
πραγματία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ (< πραγματεύομαι), [in LXX for חֵשֶׁל, etc.;]
1. careful application, hard work.
2. business, occupation: pl., .†

G4227.as:
Πούδης (in π., gen. -εντος, v. Zorell, s.v.), ὁ (Latin),
Pudens: .†

G4247.as:
** πρεσβῦτις, -ιδος, ἡ, fem, of πρεσβύτης, [in LXX: IV Mac 16:14*;]
an aged woman: .†

G4274.as:
πρό-δρομος, -ον (< προτρέχω), [in LXX: Nu 13:21 (20), Is 28:4 (בּכר), Wi 12:8*;]
running forward, going in advance. As subst., ὁ π., an advance guard, forerunner: .†

G4249.as:
πρίζω = πρίω, [in LXX: Am 1:3, Da TH Su 59*;]
to saw, saw asunder (= π. δίχα, Thuc., iv, 100): pass, (cf. δια-πρίω).†

G4265.as:
† προ-βλέπω, [in LXX: Ps 36 (37):13 (ראה)*;]
to foresee: mid., (v. Bl., § 24, 55, 1).†

G4224.as:
πότος, -ου, ὁ (< πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁתֶּה;]
a drinking bout, carousal: .†
SYN.: v.s. κραιπάλη.

G4290.as:
προθύμως, [in LXX: II Ch 29:34 (לֵבָב יִשְׁרֵי), To 7:8, al.;]
eagerly, readily, with a ready mind: .†

G4216.as:
*† ποταμο-φόρητος, -ον,
carried away by a stream: (for two exx. in π., v. MM, xxi).†
